full_name: VA Survey (100 yes/no questions about recognising everyday objects at typical viewing distances)
domains: single construct: vision ability to recognise object details (acuity demand: object size and viewing distance)
response_scale: yes / no (not applicable allowed if scenario unfamiliar)
scoring: 2PL IRT (mirt, R) vision ability theta; linear regression to estimated VA (Estimated VA = 0.59 - 0.33 x theta)
target_population: adults 18+ with a wide range of VA and diagnoses
notes: Administered by interviewer in clinic or by phone; took 30 to 60 minutes (range). Full item list in Supplementary Table S1. Item fit: 5 of 100 items misfit; 60 of 385 participants misfit. No sens/spec reported.
